items.title: Expedia Group (EXPE) Lifts 2026 Guidance As Undervalued Narrative Stays In Focus
items.summary: Expedia Group (EXPE) is back in focus after management lifted full year 2026 revenue guidance to US$16.37b to US$16.43b, paired with fresh fourth quarter forecasts and a reaffirmed US$0.48 quarterly dividend. The guidance upgrade arrived in a weak price environment for Expedia Group, with the share price down 16.65% over the past 30 days and 24.99% over 90 days, even as the 1 year total shareholder return is positive at 2.12% and the 3 year total shareholder return sits at 80.45%.
